messages:
maria_dev: hitting TLS verify error when pointing python SDK at Dedicated in our VPC.
requests.exceptions.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed (_ssl.c:1123)

maria_dev: using base_url="https://inference.prod.customer-vpc.redwood.local" and passing ca_cert_path to Client(...)

maria_dev: odd thing: sync client works with ca bundle, but the async client (aiohttp/httpx) still fails.

Tina_sdk: which sdk version are you on?

maria_dev: 0.12.2

Tina_sdk: ok. we had a bug where AsyncClient didn't propagate the `verify`/`ca_bundle` through when reusing our internal session pool. can you paste minimal repro?

maria_dev: sure:
```py
from redwood import Client

c = Client(api_key="REDACTED", base_url="https://inference.prod.customer-vpc.redwood.local", ca_bundle="/etc/ssl/custom-ca.pem")
resp = c.chat.create(model="redwood-alpha", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}])
```

maria_dev: stack trace shows verify failure coming from OpenSSL when aiohttp creates the connector

Tina_sdk: quick workaround: set the process env vars so underlying libraries pick up your CA bundle.
```bash
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/custom-ca.pem
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/custom-ca.pem
```
That forces requests/httpx/aiohttp to use your bundle even if our Client code path missed the arg.

jeff_platform: also check that your base_url includes the right host/port/path if you're behind an envoy or proxy. we had one customer using base_url without the /api prefix and hit routing 404s. example: https://inference.private:8443/api

oliver_support: confirmed workaround worked for a support case earlier today. we shipped a fix in 0.12.3 that improves verify propagation for AsyncClient and exposes a `verify` kw for async init. pls try upgrade.

maria_dev: upgraded to 0.12.3 — async client now accepts ca_bundle and the TLS error is gone. thank you! :tada:

Tina_sdk: i'll file a GH issue with your repro and link the PR, and add a docs snippet that covers env vars + Client args + proxies for Dedicated/Private. also will add a note about VPC hostnames and ports.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled — rollout v0.12.3 to hosted runners 2025-03-10 02:00 UTC

maria_dev: one more Q: corporate proxy with basic auth — any examples for proxies param?

Tina_sdk: will add this sample to docs: 
```py
Client(api_key="...", base_url="https://inference.private:8443", ca_bundle="/etc/ssl/custom-ca.pem", proxies={"https": "http://user:pass@proxy.local:3128"})
# async equivalent uses httpx/aiohttp proxy settings — we show both in the docs
```

maria_dev: perfect, that'll save time for infra teams. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
